title: An image speaks a thousand words, but can everyone listen? On image transcreation for cultural relevance

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation by native annotators from seven geographically diverse countries, who rate image-editing pipeline outputs on criteria such as cultural relevance, semantic preservation, naturalness, and offensiveness. The evaluation also includes qualitative analysis of cultural stereotyping, such as the inappropriate insertion of national flags, landmarks, or stereotypical attire.
